title: Some public endpoints return internal data or lack specific rate limits
expected: Guests see only what the product needs; guessable or expensive endpoints have their own limits; limits hold across instances.
actual: GET /api/devops/versions returns the admin release-status record to anyone. POST /api/coupons/validate returns the full coupon row (SELECT *) and is limited only by the global 500/15 min per-IP limit, so seller codes can be guessed. All rate limits are in-memory per instance (TD-026). /api/ai/status reveals the provider (negligible).
impact: Minor information disclosure; coupon codes for a seller can be enumerated; limits weaken under horizontal scaling.
fix: Require admin for devops/versions; return only {valid, discount, code} from coupon validation and add a per-IP+seller limiter; move rate limits to the Redis store when a second instance is added.
